sources.sanitization: Native macOS window captures supplied by the owner on 2026-11-07, taken in --demo mode against the in-memory S3 server; WebP with the alpha channel kept; bucket names are fictional.
observations: 2684x1750: the main window with macOS window controls and the system's own shadow on a transparent background, one per theme and per language (English and Simplified Chinese). The page picks the one for its language and theme.
inferences: The page shows the captures without a frame, border or added shadow. The Open Graph card (social.webp) is the English light capture on the page background.
limitations: The transparent margin is not suitable as an Open Graph image; the social preview composes the light capture on an opaque background.

sources.location: README.md, README.zh-CN.md, docs/cli.md, docs/cli.zh-CN.md, CHANGELOG.md, CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md, LICENSE
observations: The docs pages render these files on the site. Get started uses the README sections Install, Quick start, Command line, Build from source, Data and privacy and Platform status, in English and Chinese. The CLI reference and the changelog have Chinese counterparts kept in step with the English files; the license is shown in English only, its binding text.
inferences: Links to other repository files (source, status and design notes) stay on GitHub because they are the open-source project itself.
limitations: The prototype pages are generated by a throwaway script outside the repository; production renders the same sources in tools/site.

sources.licenseOrPermission: MIT, project-owned; the music is synthesized in code (tools/film/audio/synth.mjs)
observations: 48 s, 1080p60. The app window is the real desktop app driven frame by frame (cmd/pail-desktop/film_test.go) against the in-memory demo server of internal/demo; the intro, outro, captions and the files flying in are added in tools/film. The prototype refers to the files in docs/video/ instead of keeping a second copy, so preview it from the repository root.
limitations: Demo data only; no real account or bucket appears.
